notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating am untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating an untapped copy of the Everywhere token due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 3.
